final: WITH event_avgs AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg FROM event_avgs) SELECT ea.event_name, ea.avg_amount, ea.avg_amount - oa.overall_avg as difference, ea.avg_amount / oa.overall_avg as ratio FROM event_avgs ea CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY ea.avg_amount DESC
